Sampling only corroborates, never substitutes for, these deductions.

value.rationale: The source poses how often a named inequality of multiplicative divisor-sum functions holds. The result proves an unrestricted asymptotic gap of more than ten percentage points between odd and even inputs. Such a strict structural asymmetry is not encoded by prior global lower bounds or finite count tables. Both components are motivated and quantitatively nontrivial, and neither uses arbitrary finite slices as its final domain.
